intent_and_evidence: TripMailbox#process coordinates the incoming-email event by identifying the destination Trip through its inbound address and checking sender eligibility. It creates an InboxItem and delegates approved messages to parsing or unapproved messages to owner notification.

intent_and_evidence: TripsController#create coordinates the trip-creation event by saving the new Trip and creating its initial owner-role TripMember through Account#owner_traveler. It then delegates cover-image retrieval to FetchTripCoverImageJob.

intent_and_evidence: TripMembersController coordinates addition and removal of members in an existing Trip. It checks owner or planner authorization and resolves account travelers before creating contributor-role memberships or removing permitted memberships. Invitation delivery is delegated to InvitationMailer.

intent_and_evidence: TripItemsController#import coordinates JSON preview and confirmed batch import as one use case. Its bulk_create_items operation checks names and duplicates and creates or updates itinerary ideas before scheduling GeocodeTripItemsJob for missing coordinates.

intent_and_evidence: SessionsController#create coordinates post-OAuth identity handling by finding a UserIdentity through provider and UID or resolving a User by email. It creates missing identity links and establishes the session before accepting pending travelers and applying account-provisioning or invitation rules.

intent_and_evidence: TravelersController#create coordinates account-level traveler enrollment by validating supplied identity information and checking existing participants. It creates name-only or email-based Traveler records and links registered Users or requests invitations when applicable. This does not itself establish TripMember membership.

participant_roles: Application: MailLogger = concrete observer; MailLogger.delivered_email(message) = notification callback; ActionMailer::Base.register_observer(MailLogger) = application registration call; InvitationMailer#invite and #invite_to_trip = mail-producing collaborators; TripMailer#pending_sender_notification = mail-producing collaborator. intent_and_evidence: DaPlanStan defines MailLogger.delivered_email and explicitly registers MailLogger through ActionMailer::Base.register_observer. The Mail framework invokes the registered concrete observer during the delivery lifecycle so individual mailers do not directly call the logger.
